body_markdown:
On 9 September, BW LPG CEO Kristian Sørensen joined industry leaders at Oslo Ocean Days for a shipowners’ panel titled “Locking in growth – how do you build from a position of strength?”


The discussion centred on a challenge facing shipowners: how to make the most of opportunities in today’s market while preparing for risks over the longer term. Against a backdrop of geopolitical disruption and changing trade patterns, the panel considered investment priorities, fleet renewal and decarbonisation, as well as the role of traditional banks and alternative finance in supporting growth.


Kristian joined fellow panellists Constantin Baack of MPC Container Ships, Fridtjof Eitzen of Christiania Shipping and Zen, Atef Abou-Merhi of Pelagic Partners, and Brian Gallagher of Capital Clean Energy Carriers.


Oslo Ocean Days brought together leaders from across the ocean industries in Oslo on 9–10 September.
